newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish ZEW IPO oversubscribed, price set at PLN 45.
newsitem.headline: Polish ZEW IPO oversubscribed, price set at PLN 45.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 1,958,103 shares of 800,000-share initial public offering of Polish electrode maker Zaklady Elektrod Weglowych SA (ZEW) and the issue price was set at 45 zlotys.
ZEW said in a statement on Thursday that the orders were reduced by 62.4 percent. The minimum issue price was earlier set at 38 zlotys.
ZEW seeks a main market listing. It expects to lift net profit to about six million zlotys in 1997 from last year's 1.3 million zlotys.
